findings.source_quote: “The various traps had been checked already”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “Die verskillende strikke was reeds nagegaan” with “Die verskillende strikke was reeds nagegaan” only if this is intended to mean the traps had already been checked; otherwise use a target-language phrasing that preserves that meaning. The current text appears to say the traps were checked, so no change is clearly needed.

findings.source_quote: “their web curtains shuttered from branches overhead”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “hul webgordyne het van die takke boontoe gehang” with wording that conveys web curtains hanging down from overhead branches, e.g. “hulle webgordyne het van die takke bokant hom afgehang.”
findings.translation_quote: “hul webgordyne het van die takke boontoe gehang”

findings.suggested_fix: Replace “Die grond om Kenny was donker gevlek” with wording that preserves the sense of darkness staining the ground, such as “Die donkerte het die grond om Kenny bevlek.”
findings.translation_quote: “Die grond om Kenny was donker gevlek.”

findings.suggested_fix: Replace “Die vreemde klein groepie het haastig huis toe gegaan” with a natural Afrikaans equivalent conveying that the unusual little group hurried home, such as “Die vreemde klein geselskap het haastig huis toe gegaan.”
findings.translation_quote: “Die vreemde klein groepie het haastig huis toe gegaan”

findings.source_quote: “A narrow path winding through a leafy woodland”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “’n Smal paadjie wat deur ’n beblaarde woud kronkel” with “’n Smal paadjie wat deur ’n lowerryke woud kronkel.”
findings.translation_quote: “’n Smal paadjie wat deur ’n beblaarde woud kronkel”
